subject: general
question: In the context of Green Revolution, what does ‘H’ stand for in HYV?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ High.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With reference to the green revolution in India **'H**' in **'HYV' **stands for** high.**
 
• The **Green revolution** has involved the production of **High Yielding Variety (HYV).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Green Revolution**__

 __
 
• **Green Revolution** launched in the year **1966** and was the brainchild of **Norman Borloug.**
 
• In India, It was made successful by **DR. MS Swaminathan.**
 
• The Term '**Green Revolution**' was coined by **Dr. William Gade**.
 
• The achievement of the **Green Revolution **was a rise in cereal production especially wheat and rice,
 
• a change in cropping patterns in favor of wheat, and an increase in employment opportunities.
